title: Hospital Closing Charge: Dietary Credit by Leave Length and Unit
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — the dietary credit on the hospital closing charge.**

*Why a credit?* Meals are not prepared for a resident on leave, so the hospital closing daily charge carries a dietary credit keyed to the bed held as the reservation records it and to the leave's length from the departure date through the hospital closing entry's last day, both days counted.

*How long must the leave be?* At least 4 days, counted from the departure date through the hospital closing entry's last day with both days included. A leave of 3 days takes no credit; a leave of 4 days does.

*How much?* 16.80 per day (the memory-unit dietary credit) where the bed held is on a secure memory care tier, that is a Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room or Private Secure Memory Care Room; 14.10 per day (the standard dietary credit) where it is on any other tier.

*Which tier is looked at?* The tier of the bed held as the reservation records it.
